reading.zh: 三个平级子系统，与代码目录一一对应：Camera 拥有 Cinemachine 输出链，Character 拥有角色本体与其物理，Control 把原始输入翻译成玩法意图。三者都在 Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C 下且同属全局命名空间，因此这里的模块与目录里的文件是 1:1 对应的。
reading.en: Three sibling subsystems, one per code folder: Camera owns the Cinemachine output chain, Character owns the player body and its physics, Control turns raw input into gameplay intent. All three live under Assets/Scripts/Runtime/3C and share the global namespace, so a module here maps 1:1 to a file in that folder.
